event.text: Call 911 now. A headache that hits like a thunderclap and is the worst of your life, now with a stiff neck, can mean bleeding around the brain or another serious cause that needs emergency imaging within hours. Do not drive yourself. If you develop weakness, numbness, trouble speaking, confusion or fainting while waiting, tell the dispatcher right away.
